questions.q: Let $A$ be a $3 \times 3$ real matrix such that $A^2(A-2 I)-4(\mathrm{~A}-\mathrm{I})=\mathrm{O}$, where I and O are the identity and null matrices, respectively. If $A^5=\alpha A^2+\beta A+\gamma I$, where $\alpha, \beta$ and $\gamma$ are real constants, then $\alpha+\beta+\gamma$ is equal to:
questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & A^3-2 A^2-4 A+4 I=0 \\ & A^3=2 A^2+4 A-4 I \\ & A^4=2 A^3+4 A^2-4 A \\ & =2\left(2 A^2+4 A-4 I\right)+4 A^2-4 A \\ & A^4=8 A^2+4 A-8 I \\ & A^5=8 A^3+4 A^2-8 A \\ & =8\left(2 A^2+4 A-4 I\right)+4 A^2-8 A \\ & A^5=20 A^2+24 A-32 I \\ & \therefore \alpha=20, \beta=24, \gamma=-32 \\ & \therefore \alpha+\beta+\gamma=12\end{aligned}$

PTT=aP+(a-1)IT

questions.q: Let A be a 3×3 matrix and detA=2. If  n=detadjadj....adjA⏟2024−times, then the remainder when n is divided by 9 is equal to __________.

questions.solution:

A=2

And n=detadjadjadj...A⏟2024 times

Now, using the formula adjadjadj...A⏟r times=An−1r we get,

adjadjadj...A⏟2024 times=An−12024

⇒n=A22024

⇒n=222024 as A=2

Now, solving

22024=41012=3+11012=3k+1

⇒222024=23k+1

⇒222024=2·23k

⇒222024=2·9-1k

⇒222024=9m-2

⇒222024=9t-2+9

⇒222024=9m+7
